body:
Fixes #3222

## Attachments on sent messages
With rich chat content on (the same gate as other chat images, via `ChatMediaContext` / `FileChipProvider`):
- **Images** show as thumbnails up to 160px that load lazily near the viewport. They load from the stored copy main already makes for sent images (`mediaRef`, #2453). Older messages without one import their path through the existing local-image route (`importLocal`). Clicking a thumbnail opens `ImageLightbox` (kind `stored`). An image that can't load falls back to the name chip.
- **Audio and video** files get the same inline player cards agent messages use (`MediaCard`).
- **Other files** stay chips. A chip for a file that exists is a button that opens the existing file preview popover. A missing file stays a plain chip.
- Rich content off: every attachment is the plain name chip, as before, and nothing asks main.

The new `MessageAttachments.tsx` renders this for your messages, other agents' messages, and steered and queued ones (all go through `UserMessage`).

**Original names:** `resolveAttachments` now puts the staged `name` on image and file blocks (new optional `name` on `ContentBlock`), so a pasted image shows `screenshot.png` instead of its saved UUID name. Old transcripts fall back to the file name. Drivers map block fields explicitly, so the CLIs never see `name`. Annex's `remoteBlock` drops it too, so the phone contract is unchanged. Phone uploads carry the placeholder name `phone-image`, which the desktop now shows instead of a UUID.

## Dispatcher sender
New `findChatSenderAgent` (dispatcherStore) maps a sender that is either Dispatcher agent (chat or work id) to the Dispatcher's chat agent record, so it gets the Dispatcher's name and picture rather than "N" for Navi. `SentPart` and the chatter group summary use it.

## Validation
- New `MessageAttachments.test.tsx`: thumbnail from the stored copy, bounded size, click opens the lightbox, path import for old messages, a missing image falls back to the chip, flag off keeps plain chips with no IPC, a file chip opens the preview, a missing file stays a plain chip, audio/video cards, steer/queued, messages from other agents, `attachmentName` precedence.
- `MessageBlocks.test.tsx`: the work agent and the chat agent both render as the Dispatcher with its avatar.
- Updated exact-shape assertions in chat-attachments, chat-handlers, annex-server and ChatView tests for the new `name`.
- `npm run typecheck` clean, `npm run lint` 0 errors.
- Full `npm test`: 26589 passed, 6 failed under load (5× copilot `fixture-replay` 5s timeouts and 1 `ManagedSettings` timing lookup). Both files pass alone (54/54).
- No E2E asserts the attachment chip DOM.

title: Chat: attached images as thumbnails, file/audio/video previews, Dispatcher sender avatar (#3222)
